summary: Every client uses the reserved Sidebar arrangement id, now a generated client constant

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. operations.json gains a constants block; the generated Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients expose SIDEBAR_ARRANGEMENT_UUID.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The daemon is unchanged. The terminal UI and the phone pick the reserved subject arrangement/person/NAME/00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001 first, then the oldest live arrangement named Sidebar, as Fractal already did, and create the reserved subject when neither exists. Existing legacy Sidebars stay in use and are not copied; an arrangement not named Sidebar is no longer taken as the Sidebar.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
